cases.detail: Verilator 5.052 returns code zero but writes "Success" into the description for a successful file operation, including packed buffers. IEEE 1800-2023 21.3.7 explicitly requires the description to be cleared when the most recent operation did not produce an error. Icarus 13.0 and Celox clear both output forms; the standalone probe prints the difference.
cases.name: file_io::ferror_success_clears_description

cases.detail: Verilator 5.052 with the suite's VPI/public-signal configuration prints reactive=0 although the program output settles to 9. The standalone probe reproduces reactive=0 and settled=9 with --vpi --public-flat-rw --assert --coverage-user --x-initial 0 --x-assign 0; without those options it prints 9 for both. IEEE 1800-2023 21.2.2 requires strobe to display the time slot's final value, including Reactive program writes (24.3.1). Icarus, xezim and Celox print reactive=9.
cases.name: file_io::strobe_reads_after_reactive_program

cases.detail: Verilator 5.052 2026-09-05 rev v5.052 suppresses file monitoring after $monitoroff. IEEE 1800-2023 21.3.2 gives file monitors independent lists and no on/off counterparts. The standalone FileMonitor probe prints no file lines; Icarus and Celox print file=0 and file=1.
cases.name: file_io::fmonitor_is_independent_of_console_monitor_off

cases.detail: Verilator 5.052 2026-09-05 rev v5.052 misses a monitor display after a variable changes and returns to its previous value within one slot. IEEE 1800-2023 21.2.3 requires output when an argument changes. The standalone Transient probe prints one line instead of two; Icarus and Celox print both.
